\section{Method / 方法}
\label{sec:methods}

The synthetic kinetic energy is defined by

\begin{equation}
  E_k = \frac{1}{2} m v^2,
  \label{eq:energy}
\end{equation}

and the balanced response is represented by the two-line system

\begin{align}
  F_{\mathrm{sum}} &= F_1 + F_2, \\
  R &= \frac{F_{\max}-F_{\min}}{F_{\max}}.
  \label{eq:balance}
\end{align}

Equations~\eqref{eq:energy} and~\eqref{eq:balance} are synthetic and are used
only as conversion fixtures. 所有数值均为测试数据，不代表真实实验。
